lacks.x25519-base: OpenSSL's X25519 of the base point runs the same C (fe51) code whatever the mask
lacks.ed25519-sign: OpenSSL's Ed25519 runs the same C curve code whatever the mask; only its SHA-512 changes
lacks.ed25519-verify: OpenSSL's Ed25519 runs the same C curve code whatever the mask; only its SHA-512 changes

lacks.x25519-base: curve25519-dalek's base-point multiply is table code, the same whichever backend
lacks.x25519: curve25519-dalek's Montgomery ladder is serial field code, the same whichever backend
lacks.p256-sign: RustCrypto's p256 is pure Rust, so there is no assembly to switch off
lacks.p256-verify: RustCrypto's p256 is pure Rust, so there is no assembly to switch off
lacks.ed25519-sign: ed25519-dalek's signing multiplies the base point by table, the same whichever backend

node.portable: node:crypto is OpenSSL's libcrypto with its assembly, and Node has no switch that turns it off
